name: Queue
title: Queue - Scoped
summary: The Queue API provides methods that allow you to retrieve or join a Connect Support chat queue.
overview: To execute this class in a scoped application, use the sn_connect namespace identifier. The Connect Scriptable APIs plugin (ID: com.glide.connect.scriptable) must be enabled to access the Queue API.

members.name: get
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
SysID String Sys_id of a queue from the Chat Queue [chat_queue] table.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns a conversation queue object. 
var queue = sn_connect.Queue.get("ab73be7dc09a4300964f336ee6b74361");

members.name: join
members.summary: Adds the current user to an existing Connect Support chat queue and posts the specified question.
members.html:
Before calling this method, you must call the Scoped Queue - get(String sysID) method to retrieve the chat queue to which to attach the current user.

Parameters
Name Type Description
Question String Question to add to the chat queue.
Returns
Type Description
Object Record (GlideRecord object) in the Chat Queue Entry [chat_queue_entry] table. 
var queue = sn_connect.Queue.get("ab73be7dc09a4300964f336ee6b74361");
queue.join("How do I access my email?");
